children: U.S. President Donald Trump's disclosed holdings in nine oil and gas stocks rose by an estimated $1.5 million to $4.4 million from before the outbreak of the Iran war at the end of February through August 31, according to CNBC analysis, Ming Pao reported.
The estimated increase was equivalent to about HK$11.7 million to HK$34.32 million.

title: Trump's Oil And Gas Stock Holdings Rise By Up To $4.4 Million
